3809 Joshua Taylor Drive
Killeen, TX 76549
$230,000, 4 bed, 2.00 bath, 1,686 SF, MLS# 580012

Enjoy the distinction of this well-maintained Traditional-style! When listing all the features to be found here, be sure to note the eat-in kitchen with oak cabinets, two-car garage and ceramic tile flooring. 4 bedrooms, 2 baths. This walk-in closet lets you see wardrobe choices teamed with accessories that are all available at your finger tips. You will be very content curled up in front of the cozy fireplace. Entertain or simply relax on the comfortable covered patio. Another consideration: Laundry room. A great property offering practical appeal accompanied by charm and personality.

2 full bath
